## QA Review — Backyard Designer 3D

**Overall: Not CLEAN — functional and understandable, but a few issues worth fixing.**

### (1) Overlapping / clipped UI
- **No true overlaps detected.** Header, sidebar, canvas overlays (compass, Daytime pill, zoom stack), and bottom toolbars all have clear separation.
- The scale bar's right edge nearly touches the "Sun" button (~2px gap) — tight but not clipped.
- Sidebar's last item ("Patio") is cut off mid-row at the bottom — this reads as normal scroll cutoff, acceptable.

### (2) 5-second comprehension — mostly yes
- Clear title, obvious 3D scene, item palette on the left, and the "Getting Started" hint ("Click any item below… then drag to position it") gets a new user productive immediately. ✅

### (3) Confusing / ambiguous / broken-looking
1. **⚠️ Duplicate "Terrain" control (most confusing issue):** "Terrain" appears twice with the same mountain icon — once in the bottom-left mode card and again in the bottom-center toolbar. Same problem with "Sun & Shadow" (left card) vs. "Sun" (bottom pill). A user can't tell which does what, or if they're different modes. Rename or consolidate.
2. **⚠️ "FPS: 3" in the status bar:** a 3 fps reading makes the app look broken/severely laggy, even if it's an intentional diagnostic. Either fix the perf or hide it from the default UI.
3. **"Innovate" label is vague** — no icon/text hint at what it does (AI suggestions?). Consider a clearer label or tooltip.
4. **Cluttered bottom toolbar:** three visual clusters (left white card, center pill row, detached "Sun" + scale bar) with two rows at slightly different heights — hierarchy is unclear. Grouping into one toolbar would help.
5. **Minor:** "Brush: 8 ft" shown while Tool is "Select" — brush size is irrelevant to select mode and may confuse.

### Verdict
Layout integrity is fine; fix the duplicate Terrain/Sun controls, the FPS display, and tidy the bottom toolbar.
